description:
Main World class for Cyberpunk 2077.

This class defines how the game integrates with Archipelago's randomization system.
It handles world generation, item creation, and access logic for a single player slot.

Each player in a multiworld gets their own instance of this class, which manages
their specific randomization settings and generated world state.

0.7.0.description:
# Cyberpunk Archipelago Mod v0.7

This is probably the biggest update the mod has had to date. I believe at this point it is safe to say this mod is in the best and most stable state is has been thus far.

## Nexusmods Release!
 - The mod is now available on nexusmods to (Hopefully) make it easier to install for more players (Does not have the AP World or Poptracker included)

## New Content
 - Vendor Sanity: Progression and Filler items added to vendors around NC
 - Third Party Mod Support: Official Support added for New Game Plus - Native
 - Third Party Mod Support: Official Support confirmed with Randomizer 2077 (except Vendor Randomization and Loot Randomization (causes some quests to be unbeatable despite what the mod says))

## New YAML Options
 - New completion goals
    - Complete Main Quests: Only requires a roll credits on any ending
    - Complete Main + Side: Requires completing all paths with major companions along side rolling credits
    - Complete Phantom Liberty Only: Only requires completing the Phantom Liberty main questline
 - District Access Tokens and Weapon Access Tokens
    - Now have options (default enabled) to force the access tokens to only appear to other players worlds

## Improvements and Misc
 - A logo on the main menu! Wow!
 - Client UI in the CET Overlay has been redesigned to be more in line with other AP world clients
 - Deathlink now sends a message in the AP server
 - Substantial changes and adjustments made to the rules and AP generation which should result in very consistent and stable generation
    - The end quest of a larger quest chain (i.e the end of a major arc for panam/judy/etc.) are tagged as "priority" and will have a higher likelyhood of containing progression items in the multiworld. This was done to combat issues i was seeing where cyberpunk would hoard progression items during testing
 - NCPD Hustles (reported crime / suspected organized crime) temporarily removed as the checks were not being picked up consistently. (will revisit later)

## Fixes
 - There are so many various bug fixes and inprovements that its really impossible to list them all
0.7.0.title: Cyberpunk Archipelago Mod v0.7

v0.3.description:
Fixed:
 - Deathlink not working
 - V Being teleported from the trash heap after love like fire
 - Typo causing the disctrict enforcement to not unlock City Center
 
NOTE: If you are upgrading from 0.0.2 you will need a new YAML and a new SAVE file! Do not ask for support with sync issues if the game was NOT started while using v0.3. You will also need to remove the "{Cyberpunk Install Dir}\archive\pc\mod\CyberpunkArchipelagoMod.archive" file from your game as it contains broken quest progression.

New:
Bi-directional Progression Sync
Enforced progression blocking via District travel restrictions and required items added to the multi-world
YAML options added to control how many quests you want to include as checks

Improvements:
Lifepath choices have been consolidated into 1 check.
Point of no return (post Nocturne Op55N1) quests have been consolidated into 1 ending check.
Removed:

Quest blockers for all quests were removed from the mod due to causing hard locks even after getting the requisite item to progress
v0.3.title: Cyberpunk Archipelago Mod V0.3 Hotfix 5

v0.4.description:
# New Dependancy Required!
Phone Extension: [https://www.nexusmods.com/cyberpunk2077/mods/24949](Nexus)

# New Features
 - Traps
 - You will get new item notifications via V's phone instead of only in the  #console
 - Additional YAML options

# Bug Fixes
 - Fixed sub-district access token items being placed in the multiworld despite not being enabled as an option yet
 - Fixed items being duplicated when connected/disconnecting from the AP client (still needs more abuse testing)
 - Fixed progressive items not being cached/processed correctly
 - Fixed Regina's Psycho Killer quest being a required check even with "Include Cyberpsycho Sightings" disabled
 - Removed Blackwall Gateway from the item pool as the game does not allow it to be a quickhack and requires a specific cyberdeck

# Changes
 - Tarot cards can no longer have Progression items from the multi-world attached to them.

## Hotfix 1
- Fixed a typo in the District Enforcer script that caused City Center to not unlock

## Hotfix 2
- Fixed an issue that caused the District Restrictions to apply even with Restrict by Major District disabled
- Improved reliability of config sync

## Hotifx 3
- Fixed reverse lookup for location IDs failing causing Checks not to work
v0.4.title: Cyberpunk Archipelago Mod v0.4

v0.5.description:
# New Features
 - Weapon Restrictions: Can be set to not allow you to equip certain weapons period, or require a pass to equip them which is obtained from the multiworld

# Fixes and Improvements
 - Fixed NCPD scanner missions trigger "Gig: Hi Ho Silver Lining"
 - Beat on the Brat: Kabuki doesn't appear in the Locations list despite it being required for progression
 - Several quests listed in "Locations" were part of either cut content, or pure logic for cyberpunks quest backend and have been removed
 - Crafting components (both items and quickhacks) have been added to the filler items pool
 - Overhauled the backend ID assignment to be done at generation
 - Various generation stability improvements
 - Client <-> Game connection stability improvements (You may see the game disconnect and reconnect when loading saves, this is expected)
v0.5.title: Cyberpunk Archipelago Mod v0.5
